component.name: LinOSD
component.summary: Game performance overlay (FPS, 1% low, CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM)
Overlay de desempenho para jogos (FPS, 1% low, CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM)

description.p: LinOSD shows an on-screen display over games with FPS, frametime, 1% and 0.1% lows, a frametime graph, CPU and GPU usage, temperatures, clocks, power, RAM and VRAM, in the style of MSI Afterburner. It includes an FPS limiter and a graphical editor to customize colors, fonts, outline, shadow, background and position.

O LinOSD exibe sobre os jogos FPS, frametime, 1% e 0.1% low, gráfico de frametime, uso de CPU e GPU, temperaturas, clocks, consumo, RAM e VRAM, no estilo do MSI Afterburner. Inclui limitador de FPS e um editor gráfico para personalizar cores, fontes, contorno, sombra, plano de fundo e posição.
